meta_policy_notes: The meta-policy selects the active skill based on a prioritized evaluation of their activation rules. 'recover_upright' has the highest priority, followed by 'stabilize_standing', then 'initiate_hop', and finally 'execute_hop'. This ensures the agent first recovers from falls, then stabilizes, and only then attempts to initiate and sustain forward motion.

skills.name: recover_upright
skills.description: Bring the hopper's torso to an upright position from a fallen or highly tilted state.

reward_terms.description: Encourage reaching a stable standing height.
Penalize large deviations of torso pitch from upright (0 radians).

skills.name: stabilize_standing
skills.description: Maintain a stable, upright standing posture with minimal forward movement.

reward_terms.description: Reward maintaining the optimal standing height.
Strongly penalize any deviation of torso pitch from upright.
Penalize unwanted forward or backward movement.

skills.name: initiate_hop
skills.description: Transition from a stable standing position to starting a forward hopping motion.

reward_terms.description: Reward increasing forward velocity to initiate the hop.
Penalize pitch deviation, maintaining balance during initiation.
Encourage maintaining a good height during hop initiation.

skills.name: execute_hop
skills.description: Sustain the hopping motion and maximize forward velocity while maintaining stability.

reward_terms.description: Strongly reward high forward velocity for continuous hopping.
Slight penalty for pitch deviation, prioritizing forward motion.
Slight reward for maintaining a reasonable height during hopping.
